decisionRubricAudits.fallback: Show the material-safety checklist and omit ship-specific consumption advice.
Keep executable sortie advice blocked and show the unresolved safety checks.

If a visible unlock quest exists, show it as current-view-only. Otherwise show the exact data-acquisition step to open all quest tabs and refresh the guide. Keep the chain partial and never return an empty plan.

When totals or posture are missing or stale, keep the posture unset, show the exact step to open or refresh the local resource view, and present only non-executable conservation checks. Do not produce a sortie route.
Show the measured ASW facts and the exact steps to select a target map or mechanic and inspect the intended fleet. Without a reviewed, versioned target rule, do not emit an ASW readiness verdict.

Show category presence and absence, ask which capability and target context the user wants to inspect, and show a data-acquisition step when reviewed route or formula knowledge is unavailable. Do not select a sortie route.

Present unlocked EO only as optional long-term targets. Show the exact unresolved safety, resource, capability, route, or time check and the local screen needed to obtain it. Alternative normal-map, practice, or expedition items must be presented as checks or data-acquisition steps unless their own current conditions are verified.

Show evergreen category coverage and one explicit manual next step: ask the user to choose a category to inspect. When event participation is selected but no valid overlay exists, state that event-specific guidance is unavailable and return to evergreen preparation without an event-readiness conclusion.
